scope: Bulk source acquisition and reviewed Section 6 noun expansion. No full-paragraph gold annotation or untouched held-out claim for raw source contexts.

opendict.title: 우리말샘
opendict.scope: Complete reviewed-information export; does not include unreviewed proposals

source_count_scope: Source rows, not unique words. KRDICT 53671 unique target codes (2884 idiom/proverb child rows reuse parent IDs); OpenDict 1229498 unique target codes (32 duplicate rows). OpenDict reviewed-information export only.

selection.weight_scope: Conservative model prior, not observed corpus frequency. All baseline FST values preserved.
filters: NFC pure Hangul at least three syllables; atomic NNG; exclude source-flagged dialect/archaic/north-Korean/named entries and existing FST keys
Defer cross-source compound, alternate POS and inflected/complex-POS evidence, known decompositions, raw content-dictionary non-NNG readings and prior deferred words
At least three discovery documents; fixed gold/spoken sentences and previous reviewed evaluation documents excluded
Defer known predicate+nominalizer collisions, codebook grammatical readings and complete predicate readings in bare top-10
Review 1851 shortlisted words against up to three source senses; 108 lacked definitions, 105 remaining reviewed in 312 discovery contexts
Explicit wrong-spelling replacement is excluded; an undecided norm alone is not excluded; named and uncertain uses deferred
Protect longer existing noun boundaries; remove words whose individual removal restores confirmed surrounding-token regressions
limits: Source coarse noun labels and occurrence counts do not establish contextual Sejong NNG truth.
Selection used inspected discovery/evaluation contexts and repeated fixed benchmarks. Results are post-selection validation, not untouched held-out estimates.
All 55 confirmed regressions were individually ablated and checked again in the final model. Other paragraph tokens are not exhaustively gold-labeled.
The strict lost-token screen contains internal lexical repairs and imperfect baseline analyses; unlabelled screen rows are not counted as verified improvements.

corpus_support.source_reference_scope: Original file, document and paragraph IDs plus SHA256; no source paragraphs copied into this report.

scoring.fixed: ep_norm normalized form/POS multiset micro F1
scoring.mp: Per-sentence form/POS set F1 with raw and norm2025 views; not identical to fixed scorer. MP2021 overlaps model training.

lexical_metric_scope: Exact proposed word/POS at recorded offsets; not paragraph F1. Replay compares committed 190e baseline with final 5c candidate; incremental tables compare 6694 with 5c.

context_regression_ablation.reason: The antonym of right/correct is adjectival here. VA becomes VV.
Petrochemical-related is resegmented from chemical+suffix to suffix+academic-community; the correct chemical boundary is lost.
The bakery menu item an-butter becomes an/MAG+butter. The bean-paste component is not an adverb.
The predicate give an explanation plus nominalizer becomes a noun and nominal suffix. The following auxiliary+connective also becomes a conjunction.
The sentence-final polite ending becomes EF+EC, incorrectly labeling the final polite element as a connective ending.
Low-irritation loses prefix+irritation and becomes author+pole/play, an unrelated segmentation.
The negative adverb in cannot adapt becomes a noun and the following predicate becomes XSV.
Egg plus topic particle in eggs in the nest becomes a verb stem plus adnominal ending.
Sentence-initial first-person pronoun becomes XSN despite no preceding nominal host.
The subway stops: the prior stem was already imperfect, but auxiliary+adnominal ending was valid. It becomes the imported noun plus topic particle.
In urinate and wash down, the connective ending becomes NNG. The preexisting incorrect nominal stem is not claimed correct.
The anatomical noun component of vaginitis becomes a nominal derivational suffix.
You went with me to a palace: the companion JKB becomes JC, coordinating a person and destination.
The final colloquial clause ending becomes a temporal/dependent noun; the old EC versus EF convention is a separate issue.
Being close friends with Zhang Liang takes a relational JKB, not JC coordinating the person and friendship noun.
The adnominal description pointed has adjectival meaning; XSA becomes VV. The old MAG tag on the root was already imperfect.
All are close friends with me: companion JKB becomes JC.
Being in balance with his globalism is a relational construction, not coordination of globalism and balance.
Particles are classified as mesons and baryons; coordination JC becomes JKB.
The intact place name Sidon is split into a common noun and particle.
A Chinese four-character idiom is resegmented with a Korean subject particle for the Chinese connective character.
I was a working-holiday visitor: first-person pronoun+topic becomes a verb+adnominal ending.
The term-definition construction loses its particle to an NNP reading of the same suffix.
Stone in the explicitly named actor Sharon Stone changes from NNP to NNG.
India in an explicitly geographical reference changes from NNP to NNG.
The full paragraph lists three councils; the conjunction before the final council changes from JC to JKB.
Those who became different: dependent noun person+topic becomes sleep/VV+adnominal ending.
After -기도, 하다 expresses an additional possible action: auxiliary verb. KRDICT 62888 sense 6.
The text means my style, not the verb 내다.
This reports what is said; 하다 is the saying/reporting main verb (KRDICT 73277), not the auxiliary -기도/-고는 하다.
Meaning even if a voice crack occurs; 나다 is the predicate, not I too.
댁 denotes the house where a room is available; it is an independent noun (KRDICT 64392).
가져가다 is a dictionary verb (KRDICT 53811). Movement/taking is not auxiliary 가다 here.
Baseline 줄/NNB was already wrong for a visible line (NNG); its subject boundary 이/JKS was correct and is lost.
The promise is made with the rooster. 수평아리와 약속 is not a coordinated noun list.
결국 modifies 죽였고, with no noun argument role. KRDICT adverb 17260.
Final occurrence regresses; a different 결국 at offset 316 improves NNG -> MAG in the same paragraph.
결국 modifies the predicate 아우르며, not a nominal argument.
The quoted noun is the predicate with omitted surface 이; the copula must remain in morphological analysis.
Baseline internal noun analysis was wrong, but 은/JX was correct. The new output absorbs the topic particle.
This is a complete interrogative sentence. Segmentation of 요 can vary, but EC for its interrogative ending is wrong.
This is 기+이다+nominalizer 기, not the dictionary noun 기이기. Baseline 기/XSN was wrong, but VCP/ETN were correct. Other nearby changes improve 스스로 and 는; the row is mixed.
An intact Bible book title becomes a place noun plus locative particle. NNG versus NNP naming conventions do not justify splitting the book-name ending into JKB.
The predicate nominalization and complement particle in repayment rather than something else are swallowed into one NNG.
The noun stem was already split, but the correctly separated coordinating particle is newly swallowed into NNG.
The coordinating particle between two medicines is newly swallowed into the preceding chemical-name NNG.
After the overt object vegetarian diet, the predicate did plus adnominal ending becomes the determiner one.
The intact protein name granzyme is broken into an interjection, adnominal ending and unrelated nominal fragment.
Recorder plus coordinating particle becomes recording plus the unrelated noun roof tile.
The correct antigen plus copula/adnominal ending is resegmented as unrelated nouns.
The falling/declining predicate in the growth-stock comparison loses its verb-forming suffix and connective to a noun reading.
Camping fire supplies are types of charcoal to buy; the charcoal noun becomes burned/VV plus adnominal ending.
The possessive pronoun before his own grandfather becomes an unattached nominal suffix.
The preexisting interjection tag on sound was imperfect, but the correctly separated location/topic particles are newly swallowed into NNG.
This is called a three-moves teaching: demonstrative object pronoun becomes a verb with adnominal ending.

final_guards.scope: Ordered exact form/POS/start/end subsequence in Node/WASM replay.

mp_scope: MP2021 no changed outputs; MP2025 three changed rows. 아샷추 and 한능검 recover references. 재초환법 remains NNG 재초환+법 versus gold NNP 재초환법: reduced false positives, not a full correction.
runtime_scope: Native versus existing Node/WASM; zero form/POS differences over 33617 inputs per model. Same two pre-existing span differences (spoken rows8004/8017), max score difference0.000244140625. No browser UI test.
benchmark_scope: 1250 inputs: fixed gold every ninth row plus first250 selected discovery contexts; warmup50, seven alternating pairs. Native Analyzer.analyze only; WASM public API including result conversion. Model loading and input/output excluded. No clear speed change.
